_comment: Objects this repository hosts ON PURPOSE that the upstream asset tree does not contain. They are deliberately outside the upstream mirror, so a prune pass (which deletes keys upstream no longer lists) must never remove them. Everything here was checked against the CDN index before upload: every path was absent, so nothing upstream was overwritten.
_why_a_list: The prune step is the one operation that can destroy content we host for someone else. A comment in the sync code would not survive; a list that the prune reads cannot be missed.
